1. Two runs of the U-shaped bench (DH-LAY-P1), unfolded and drawn true scale 1:15. Run 2 is drawn above run 1.
2. One operator fills, one caps and seals, one labels and packs; the bench is loaded to 29 % (line balance).
3. Container change: swap the printed nest and grip, then a first-off label and weight check in the MES.
4. Metal detector P1-406 (used): validate sensitivity on site with certified test pieces before release.
5. All units weighed: under declared are rejected; the lot is accepted by the MES HB 133 check.
